_comment: events.json — Featured events on the Home tab. GENERATED from the-leo/data/featured-events.js by scripts/build-events-json.cjs; edit that file, then regenerate. Two date styles: (A) "date": "2026-11-18T17:30:00" (+ optional "endDate") — exact time, works on all app versions; (B) "day": "2026-10-30" (+ optional "time", "endDay", "repeat": "weekly") — shown on app v1.0.9+ only. Past events auto-hide. Optional: url (https or mailto), linkLabel, poster + posterAspect (v1.0.9+).

events.title: Wednesday Night Live
events.blurb: Mass at 5:00, parish dinner at 5:30, then classes and groups for every age at 6:30 — plus Confession and Adoration. Nursery available 6–8 PM.

events.title: All Hallows Eve Festival
events.blurb: Inflatables, face painting, costume contests, pumpkin decorating, games, and more!

events.title: St. Mark Community Service Day
events.blurb: Saint Mark parishioners will come together to serve throughout Birmingham and our surrounding communities alongside Habitat for Humanity, Holy Rosary Food Pantry, Cahaba Medical Care, Riverkeepers Society, Pathways, La Casita, Life on Wheels, and Saint Mark on-campus support. Sign up and choose where you'd like to serve!

events.title: Thanksgiving Meal
events.blurb: Give thanks together over a shared parish meal.

events.title: Deck the Halls
events.blurb: Bring the whole family, get into the Christmas spirit, and help us decorate Saint Mark! Refreshments provided. Please email Kelley Olis to be added to the head count.

events.title: The Vigil Project
events.blurb: Way of the Star: a one-night Advent mission experience of scripture, music, art, and Eucharistic encounter, presented by Saint Mark and Arise Worship Ministry. Confession will be available.

events.title: Advent Festival & Market
events.blurb: Saint Mark's first-ever Advent Festival: four days of concerts, a tree lighting, Christmas market, live nativity, and children's activities.
